card.name: Shake-before-use instructions, ahead of well
card.fires_on: The word right after a shake instruction, usually the name of a liquid form such as suspension or spray, where an adverb like well or gently is expected next. Also fires on the verb be in 'the line should be flushed'.

modes.label: Shake the liquid
modes.description: The form noun (suspension, spray) or SHAKE itself in an instruction to shake before use.
modes.example: Shake the<< suspension>> before each use.

modes.label: Line flushing
modes.description: The word 'be' in 'the line should be flushed' for IV lines used for several drugs.
modes.example: the line should<< be>> flushed before and after infusion of SIV

modes.label: Handling a skin fold
modes.description: A pronoun after a verb of handling, where a manner word could follow.
modes.example: pulling<< it>> away from the body ( Figure I ).

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing 'well' or 'good' as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot in 'shake the suspension' where the next word is likely to be 'well'.
